title: Stewart Brewing
subtitle: Beer labels designed from the inside out to present the hidden elements of craft in each brew.
intro: Stewart Brewing's Project 7 series exists to give its brewers complete creative freedom — each small batch a deliberate experiment in pushing what beer can taste and feel like. I was selected to bring the new range to life by creating a standalone brand and label design that would establish this experimental project in the eyes of beer lovers across the UK.
challenge: Each beer in the series is entirely distinct — different ingredients, different processes, different character. The packaging needed a visual system flexible enough to give each beer its own identity while still reading as a coherent series on shelf.
approach: We looked closely at the process and chose to conceptualise and present the microscopic elements and secret ingredients that make each brew special — what we called the Elements of Craft. Each beer's ingredients and process were translated into a unique 3D molecular form — inspired by medical imaging and microscopic organisms. An AR app extended the idea further: point your phone at the can, summon the element, and explore its unique character via virtual microscope.
outcome: The system proved extensible by design — as new beers joined the series, new elements were created to match the flavours, the ingredients and the character of each beer. The project won Best Concept Design at the SIBA Business Awards 2019, recognising both the packaging concept and the AR experience as an authentic celebration of the brewing craft. Over the course of our partnership, we developed labels for 19 different beers that helped establish Stewart Brewing as true champions of the craft with thousands of new fans.
